보다.gloss: to see, to watch; to take (an exam)

meanings.en: to see, to look at, to watch
meanings.note: Primary meaning.
Idiomatic in 시험을 보다.

examples.trans: I watched a movie on the weekend.
I took the driver's license exam.

examples.text: 그러니까 저한테 잘하셔야 돼요. 철저히 제 편, 아시겠죠?

meanings.en: to do, to perform, to hold
meanings.note: Core verb; also combines with nouns to form verbs.

examples.trans: What are you doing right now?
We are holding a meeting today.

examples.text: 촬영 원본 못 보여 준다 그랬더니 직접 현장으로 온 거 아닐까?

meanings.note: verb to remain

examples.trans: Money is left.

meanings.note: Used in spoken Korean dialogue (noun).

meanings.note: Demonstrative pronoun referring to something near the listener or already mentioned. Routinely spoken as 그거. RR: geugeot; spoken geugeo.

examples.trans: That is my mobile phone.

Did you hear about this tapes?

meanings.note: Used in -(으)ㄴ/는 것 같다 to express 'it seems that...' or 'I think...'.

meanings.en: to be the same, to be like
meanings.note: Compares two things with -와/과 같다.

examples.trans: I think I'm late.

examples.trans: This is my bag.

meanings.note: bound noun used in -(으)ㄴ 적이 있다/없다 ('have/haven't ever done')

없다.gloss: to not exist, to not have

examples.trans: I don't have time right now.

meanings.note: Honorific noun and counter for people, used instead of 사람.

meanings.note: Can also function as a noun

meanings.en: to like, to be fond of
meanings.note: Takes an object marked with 을/를.

examples.trans: What kind of food do you like?

meanings.note: Combines with 하다 in 말하다 (to speak, to say).

examples.trans: I don't know what you mean.

meanings.en: to be unable to, cannot do

meanings.note: Used colloquially for positive or negative emphasis.

examples.trans: The weather is so nice today.

meanings.note: Available time or duration.

examples.trans: Do you have time?

meanings.note: Placed before a verb to express inability or impossibility.

examples.text: 어제는 너무 피곤해서 잠을 못 잤어요.

meanings.note: Refers to both the act of broadcasting and the aired program itself.

examples.trans: That program airs on Sunday evening.

meanings.note: Commonly used for traffic or workplace accidents

examples.trans: A big traffic accident happened on the road.

examples.text: 조심하지 않으면 사고가 날 수 있어요.
examples.trans: If you are not careful, an accident can happen.

meanings.en: to arise, to come up, to occur
meanings.note: Used with feelings, thoughts, or events (e.g. 실감이 나다, 생각이 나다).

examples.trans: A good idea came to mind.

examples.text: 이번 일은 꼭 잘 해결해 봐요, 책임지다는 마음으로요.

meanings.note: Used in standard farewells 안녕히 계세요 and 안녕히 가세요.

examples.trans: Goodbye! (to someone staying)
